svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hat section: from 2 mm galvanized strip 84 mm wide, folded to two

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 22 mm flanges, two 45 degree sides and a 16 mm wide top, 16 mm high

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: overall. Fold in a sheet folder; cut lengths with a grinder.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Paint the cut ends with zinc paint; file all edges smooth.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 455 mm of hat section. At one end cut away the top and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sides for 26 mm, leaving the two flanges; fold the flanges down

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 90 degrees 22 mm from their ends to make the tabs (429 mm raised).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 9 mm holes in the flanges, 32 mm from the centre line, 110 and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 330 mm from the curb end; a 9 mm hole in each tab, 11 mm down.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Grind a 45 degree bevel on the flange edges so it is not a trip edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: across the sidewalk from the curb edge to 1 mm short of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: riser guard; four M8 anchors, security nuts; tabs share the curb

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cover's upper anchors. Paint it yellow or fit hazard tape.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: no edge stands more than 2 mm off the sidewalk.
